product_name: Grok Bot · cross-app research and drafting

scope.experience: A persistent cloud Bot completing a bounded research task across apps and returning review-ready drafts
scope.task: Read a CRM review list, research selected accounts through approved web and Slack sources, and return source-linked findings and outreach drafts for human review.
scope.configuration: One Bot on its cloud computer with approved source access and local artifact creation. Auto Review is assumed enabled with narrow read/prepare permissions and ask-first boundaries for external changes. Human takeover handles login steps; sending outreach or editing business records is excluded. No particular subscription, model or rule configuration was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: A business knowledge worker delegating research and reviewing drafts across familiar tools

conversational.rationale: Natural-language messages initiate work, clarify goals and steer revisions, alongside task updates, computer handoffs and approval controls.
conversational.uncertainty: The assessed experience emphasizes completing delegated work rather than unrestricted conversation; voice interaction is not assessed.

specialization.rationale: Persistent job context and connected apps focus the Bot on operational work, but the product can research, draft and manipulate artifacts across many domains rather than one fixed specialist task.
specialization.uncertainty: The CRM research task is an example of the general cross-app agent, not a separately configured sales-only product. A narrowly configured specialist Bot would need its own assessment.

autonomy.rationale: From one delegated outcome the Bot can choose browser or connector steps, gather information and prepare files on a persistent cloud computer while the user's laptop is closed.
autonomy.uncertainty: This estimate assumes bounded source access, human login handoffs and review before external changes. Auto Review is model-based; no approval enforcement, recovery or end-to-end execution was tested.

explainability.rationale: The conversation exposes file and tool-result cards, a view of computer actions and proposed operations for approval; source-linked artifacts let the user inspect findings and resulting work.
explainability.uncertainty: Source links and visible actions aid inspection but do not establish complete logs, correct findings or faithful access to the model's internal reasoning.

accessibility.rationale: Message-based setup and desktop/mobile access support knowledge workers beyond programmers, but using the product effectively requires an eligible plan, connected-account setup and understanding of the source systems and review task.
accessibility.uncertainty: Target-demographic reach is an estimate. Plan eligibility, cloud storage requirements and app permissions limit access; no onboarding, language, usability or assistive-technology trials were performed.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-19; no live product tests. Scope: Grok Bot's persistent cloud-computer research and drafting workflow with approved source access and human review before external changes. Ordinary Grok chat, coding, schedules, multi-Bot orchestration and local execution are excluded. Scores use rubric v1 and are design estimates. Sources: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview , https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/get-started , https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/computer-and-apps , https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/files-and-results and https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/approvals-security-and-privacy .
